camel_example: aliyun iot UpdateEdgeInstanceChannel --region cn-hangzhou --Configs.1.Content 'protocol_:_TCP_,_ip_:_1.2.3.4_,_port_:122' --DriverId 9c1ae7bd59f1469abbdccc9592000000 --Configs.1.Key key1 --ChannelName le_name_update --InstanceId 6GaTtvTj7vJhiS000000 --Configs.1.Format JSON --ChannelId BE0BD49EF5EF4D119D09CC1B25000000
description_en: Updates a driver channel in an edge instance
description_zh: 调用该接口更新边缘实例中的驱动通道
kebab_example: aliyun iot update-edge-instance-channel --instance-id 6GaTtvTj7vJhiS000000 --driver-id 9c1ae7bd59f1469abbdccc9592000000 --channel-id BE0BD49EF5EF4D119D09CC1B25000000 --channel-name le_name_update --configs Format=JSON Content=protocol_:_TCP_,_ip_:_1.2.3.4_,_port_:122 Key=key1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEdgeInstanceChannel

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You do not need to specify this parameter for public instances, but you must specify it for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), move the pointer over the name of the target edge instance to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the driver. On the Drivers page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), move the pointer over the name of the target driver to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
驱动ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的驱动管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the driver channel. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/162253.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the driver channel. The name must be 1 to 30 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase English letters, digits, and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 驱动通道名称。支持中文、英文大小写字母、数字和下划线（_），长度限制1~30个字符
parameters.name: channel_name

fields.help_en:
The content of the configuration.

If the Configs.N.Format parameter is set to KV or JSON, specify the configuration content. For more information about the configuration content format, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172321.html.

If the Configs.N.Format parameter is set to FILE, specify the URL of the configuration file in Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155858.html operation to obtain the OSS URL
fields.help_zh:
配置内容。

Configs.N.Format参数的值为KV或JSON时，此处请填写配置内容。配置内容格式，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172321.html。

Configs.N.Format参数的值为FILE时，此处请填写阿里云对象存储OSS地址。OSS地址请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155858.html接口获取
fields.name: content

fields.help_en:
The format of the configuration. Valid values:
KV: key-value pair configuration
JSON: JSON format
FILE: configuration file
fields.help_zh: 配置格式。取值有KV（键值对配置）、JSON（JSON格式）、FILE（配置文件）
fields.name: format

fields.help_en: The key of the configuration. This parameter is used to distinguish configurations when multiple configurations exist
fields.help_zh: 配置的关键字。在有多个配置的情况下，用于区分配置
fields.name: key

Code.description_en: The return code of the operation. A value of Success indicates that the call was successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
